name: Southwest Turkey Burger with Aioli, Onion, Avocado & Mixed Green Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the cilantro. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Add turkey, bread crumbs, and spices to the bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 6 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ground turkey
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tbsp paprika
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, place mayo and additional spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the aioli and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp paprika
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and salt in another large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp honey
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise, then slice into thin strips; halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Peel and slice onions crosswise into thin rings.
Halve and pit avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
Just before serving, add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; toss to combine the salad.
Place bottom half of each bun on a plate; spread with aioli, then layer with burger patties, onion, and avocado. Close with the top half of each bun and serve with salad on the side. Enjoy!
